city_extent: No accepted district geometry in this release
join_key: district_code (not used by included weather sample)

layers.spatial_support: One provider-resolved kilometer-scale model grid cell near the Astana reference point; not district-level
layers.license: CC BY 4.0 data; Open-Meteo free API access is non-commercial only
layers.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com/), licensed under CC BY 4.0.
layers.transformations: Raw API JSON retained; compact daily sample excerpted without changing values. See weather/README.md for retrieval and interpretation.

layers.spatial_support: Point features within the Astana reference bbox (51.0, 71.2, 51.3, 71.7), tagged amenity=school; not an official or complete school register
layers.transformations: OSM nodes retained as points; ways/relations represented by Overpass-provided center points; only selected descriptive tags and OSM object IDs retained

limitations: This partial package contains no district geometry and no district-level observations.
The weather sample is dated and must not be displayed as current after its valid period.
Open-Meteo free API terms do not permit commercial use; recheck terms before redistribution or commercial operation.
No layer in this package changes existing indicators, weights, initiatives, population shares, or score calculation.
